questions.stem: A line of best fit should:

options.text: Follow the general trend with roughly equal numbers of points above and below
Connect the first and last data points

questions.explanation: A line of best fit should follow the general trend of the data with approximately equal numbers of points above and below the line. It does not need to pass through any specific points or the origin.

questions.stem: Using a line of best fit to estimate a value within the range of the data is called:
questions.explanation: Interpolation is estimating a value within the range of the given data. Extrapolation is estimating beyond the range and is less reliable.
